title: A framed echo server
prompt:
1. `static String frame(String message)` — return the wire form: message + "\n".
2. `static java.util.List<String> deframe(String received)` — split a received chunk
into complete frames: split on "\n" and DROP a trailing fragment that lacks its
terminator (an incomplete frame is not a frame). Empty input → empty list.
3. `static byte[] lengthFrame(String payload)` — binary framing: 4-byte big-endian
length prefix followed by UTF-8 payload bytes.
4. `static int prefixLength(byte[] framed)` — read the 4-byte big-endian prefix back.

tests.name: newline framing round-trips
length-prefix framing
tests.hint: The prefix is arithmetic, not guesswork.
